source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 8 May 1924, p. 5 ("Belfast rural council: only five nominations for nine seats in Castlereagh")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: names and divisions read on the block image of the News-Letter's nomination list of 8 May 1924

note: Triennial election of the nineteen district electoral divisions of Kilkeel rural district, one member each. Ten candidates (all Unionists) were nominated on 7 May 1924 and returned unopposed; in the remaining nine divisions no nominations were received (Belfast News-Letter, 8 May 1924) and the vacancies were filled later by co-option. Sole nomination (Unionist). Returned unopposed.
